question: What ritual sequence connects worship in the mandala with the fire offering?
premises: All gods in the mandala have been worshipped.
They are to be worshipped again.
A fire offering follows the worship.
inference: After worshipping all the gods honored in the mandala, one should make offerings into the fire for them.
plain_english: Having worshipped all the gods honored in the mandala, one should make fire offerings to them.
